#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | The customer's id (cus_…). |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `currency` | `string` | no | The config's currency. Default: the customer's. |
| `unit` | `string` | no | The credit unit's id. Omit for money credit. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `auto_topup`. One of `auto_topup`. |
| `id` | `string` | atu_… |
| `customer` | `string` | cus_… |
| `currency` | `string` | ISO currency. |
| `unit` | `string` | The credit unit's id. |
| `trigger` | `string` | What started the auto topup. One of `threshold`, `schedule`. |
| `threshold_minor` | `integer` | The threshold. |
| `threshold_units` | `string` | The threshold in credits, for a unit with no money rate. |
| `pack_price` | `string` | The credit pack a run buys, for a unit with no money rate. |
| `pack_quantity` | `integer` | Packs in one purchase. |
| `target_units` | `string` | The balance in credits that a run buys up to. |
| `purchase_limits` | `object` | The most that automatic top-up can buy in the last hour, this day, the last 7 days and this month. Day and month follow the business's time zone. A purchase that would pass a limit is skipped (`credit_auto_topup_skipped`, reason `purchase_limit`). Unset = no limit for that window. |
| `schedule` | `object` | `{every: week, weekday: 1–7}` (ISO, 1 = Monday) or `{every: month, day: 1–31}`. A day past the month's end runs on its last day. |
| `method` | `string` | The method. One of `fixed`, `target`. |
| `amount_minor` | `integer` | The fixed amount. With `pack_price`: the price of one purchase when it was saved. |
| `target_minor` | `integer` | The target balance. |
| `monthly_cap_minor` | `integer` | The monthly cap. |
| `max_runs_per_day` | `integer` | Runs per day. |
| `payment_method` | `string` | pm_… |
| `has_payment_method` | `boolean` | False when a run has no payment method to charge: the named method, or every method in the charge order, is invalid. Enable is then refused. |
| `grant` | `object` | The credit each run buys. |
| `status` | `string` | The auto topup's status. One of `active`, `disabled`. |
| `disabled_reason` | `string` | payment_declined, retries_exhausted, operator or customer. |
| `disabled_at` | `string` | ISO 8601. |
| `threshold_low_at` | `string` | Last `credit_auto_topup_threshold_low`, ISO 8601. |
| `lead_time` | `object` | The notice lead rule on the payment method a run charges first (read and save). `required_threshold_minor` = `lead_hours` of usage at the current rate. |
| `created_at` | `string` | ISO 8601. |
| `updated_at` | `string` | ISO 8601. |
| `resource_version` | `integer` | Version. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The automatic top-up. |
| `404` | No such customer, or no automatic top-up. |

```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/auto_topup" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
